bio: Zanetta Passarin, a sturdy and capable woman of the facchini class, has built an impressive fortune through shrewd business acumen and relentless work ethic at the bustling gondola station where she manages porters and coordinates water transportation. Born to a family of dockworkers who have called the Castello district home for generations, Zanetta inherited her father's exceptional strength and her mother's keen eye for opportunity.
